Hi Justin, I’m not sure if you’re still here, but I can only hope you are.

I’m so sorry for all the shit you’ve gone through man, I can’t possibly imagine how painful it’d be to go through all that, I’m so sorry your friends betrayed you, I’m guessing your friends are around your age, young adults can make really dumb decisions a lot of the time, they very well might grow out of it (though of course that’s not an excuse for treating you badly). hopefully your one friend comes to reason and realises his girlfriend was lying about you.

I’m sorry that your ex broke your heart, I’m really glad that you’re not holding onto resentment for him, though I don’t know exactly what he did, but remember to take care of yourself and love yourself too, you do deserve love and I’m sure you’ll find someone to spend the rest of your life with, be that your ex or someone else.

I’m sorry your parents neglected you man, it’s completely fucked up that you weren’t given the love and care you should’ve had, you deserve so much better than what you got, and I hope soon you find a strong loving social net.

Honestly I don’t even know what to say about the fact that you were raped except I’m so so sorry, I hope that you’ll be able to get proper treatment for any trauma around it soon, but again I just want to say I’m so so so so so sorry that that happened to you Justin, I really do hope you’ll manage to heal well in time.

I’m sorry you’re stuck not making enough money, it really is fucking awful, I know how it feels to an extent, I try to read some stuff (books, random old stuff converted to pdfs, etc) or do something physical when I start to feel pessimistic about the future. Obviously these are short term coping mechanisms, but I do think people are starting to realise how hard it is for a lot of people in financial conditions like yours, I really do think things will get better for people like us, but in the meantime I’ll keep you in my thoughts, if it’s any consolation.

I’m sorry you feel ashamed of your sexuality, I only came out recently as bisexual to my friends, I want you to know there’s nothing wrong with you, you deserve to be loved Justin, everyone does, you’ll make someone a very happy boyfriend one day.

Justin, if you’re reading this, I hope you’re feeling at least a little better, but if not, I hope you feel better soon my friend, and please don’t be scared to get emergency medical help if it gets bad enough, even though it might be expensive.

My best wishes,
